description: Objective, deterministically-scored prompt set for comparing two served LLMs on quality + (alongside) performance. Each item is checkable without an LLM judge: the model's FINAL answer (reasoning stripped) is normalized (lowercased, punctuation-trimmed) and matched against `expect` per `mode` (contains=any present, all=all present, exact=normalized equality). Phrased to elicit a short, checkable answer so reasoning and non-reasoning models are scored on the same ground.
perf_prompt: Write a detailed, technical explanation of how a four-stroke internal combustion engine works, covering intake, compression, power, and exhaust.
